$comment: Prerequisite edges. mt_agentic_loop_cc is the single entry point (no hard prerequisites).

dependencies.reason: EPCC is how the loop's plan/act/verify phases get named and separated into a recommended workflow
Commit is the last EPCC phase; the pre-commit review habit only makes sense once code exists to review
Permission modes govern how far each loop iteration's action can go before it needs to ask
Auto is one of the six modes; its classifier behavior only makes sense against the full spectrum
Plan mode is itself one of the six permission modes, so choosing it requires knowing the spectrum it sits in
The interview pattern is a plan-mode-adjacent technique for surfacing considerations before implementation begins
The Explore subagent exists specifically to keep plan mode's discovery phase from filling main context
CLAUDE.md is read every session and appended to the same prompt the loop starts from
The four-location stack only matters once you know a single file is auto-loaded
@import composes conventions across the same locations the hierarchy defines
.claude/rules/ is an alternative to a single growing project-level file within that same hierarchy
Phrasing advice applies once you're actually writing rules into a CLAUDE.md file
Deciding where a rule belongs presupposes knowing what CLAUDE.md is and how much weight its phrasing carries
Commands share the same project-vs-personal location split CLAUDE.md's hierarchy already established
Skills are one of the three mechanisms rule_placement distinguishes, so their config presupposes that distinction
A verification skill is a skill; authoring one presupposes knowing skill frontmatter
Compaction operates on the same context the loop accumulates turn by turn
/clear and /context are the other two levers in the same session-steering toolkit as /compact
Rewind operates on the same per-prompt checkpoints the loop creates
/goal and /loop are session-steering commands introduced alongside /compact
A worktree isolates the file tree a given loop instance acts on
Hooks are the mechanism rule_placement identifies for rules that must never be skippable
Exit codes are how a hook communicates its decision back for a given event
permissionDecision is the PreToolUse-specific payload layered on top of the general exit-code contract
updatedInput is a value the PreToolUse decision response can carry alongside permissionDecision
The compact matcher is a SessionStart-specific trigger, so it presupposes knowing the event lifecycle
The compact matcher only makes sense against knowing what /compact actually does to a session
MCP servers are configured before the loop starts, and their tools become available to every iteration
The context tax is a direct consequence of how many servers scoping wires in
Preferring abstract, general tools is one response to the same context-budget pressure MCP servers create
A subagent runs its own instance of the same loop inside an isolated context window
Preloading applies to a subagent's context, so it presupposes knowing how a subagent's context is isolated
Preloading a skill into a subagent combines subagent isolation with how a skill's content loads in the first place
All three automation modes are ways of running the same loop without a human watching each turn
Routines are one point on the spectrum this topic maps
Headless mode is the second point on the same spectrum
The GitHub Action is effectively a headless-mode deployment target inside CI
A plugin bundles the same skill/hook/MCP mechanisms rule_placement distinguishes into one installable unit
How much verification a run needs scales with how far it sits from interactive supervision on that spectrum
A Stop hook gate is the hook mechanism applied specifically to enforce the verification a run needs
Gating with a hook is the concrete answer to how much verification an unsupervised run needs
Cold review before commit is the single-session version of what a cold second opinion generalizes further
The checklist synthesizes gated verification into its 'run the checks' step
The checklist's last step is exactly when to bring in a cold second opinion
The checklist's 'least privilege' step presupposes knowing which mechanism should be enforcing what
